name: Pétervására (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner with diagonal stripes of white and red, charged at the bottom with the town arms of Pétervására: a blue shield with a helm and red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pétervására arms with helm and mantling
